items.name: Schwerin Open 2027
items.information: Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern begrüßen zu dürfen! We are very excited to welcome you all to the second official speedcubing competition in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern!

items.name: Rocky Face 2027
items.information: **Please note that outside food is not allowed in the venue.** If you would like to eat on-site, the venue will be operating a concession stand throughout the competition. Any food not purchased at that concession stand cannot be brought into the venue. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RockyFace2027#80185-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)

items.name: Forget Nothing Redondo Beach 2027

venue.name: Redondo Beach Main Public Library
venue.address: 303 N Pacific Coast Hwy Redondo Beach, CA 90277

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/forgetnothingredondobeach2027#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/)
